in_text_mentions: A further 3-tesla brain MRI scan was performed during the current pregnancy, at 30 weeks of gestation and 33 years of age. The scan demonstrated a nidus measuring 9.4 × 6.6 × 4.2 cm in the right parieto-temporo-occipital lobe, classified as S-M Grade V. in_text_mentions: The case involves a 37-year-old female who was diagnosed with undifferentiated immunodeficiency syndrome and protein-losing gastroenteropathy at the age of 26.
